items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: I knew Max well. Max was really my start into the music. And he was a big help in my career.

ctx.x: Yeah it would because I think — I never met Duke Ellington or Mingus. I knew Max, I knew Max well. Max was really my start into the music. And he was a big help in my career. But just knowing, like I said, there again, understanding him, what he played for, his intentions and everything, his love for the music, his love for history. I knew how, and when you hear all of those guys talking about Duke Ellington, there’s a deep respect. You know what I mean? So with guys like that I don’t care who everybody else is…

we’re going to make this work you know. So those guys, their intent and their love for the music, you figure that’s going to carry. Mingus or another great bassist and a great composer, and you have an opportunity to work with Duke Ellington, of course.
